findings.title: Public findMany method removed without caller migration
findings.body: packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts replaces the public findMany(findManyArgs) method that queried bookingTimeStatusDenormalized with getBaseConditions() returning Prisma.Sql. The diff deletes findMany and no other file in this PR updates callers. Any existing caller using service.findMany({ select, where }) will fail to compile or throw at runtime, which is a breaking contract change.

findings.title: Org/team ANY() SQL never executed against database
findings.body: packages/lib/server/service/__tests__/insightsBooking.integration-test.ts only executes user-scope conditions via prisma.$queryRaw. Team-scope and org-scope authorization uses teamId = ANY(array) and userId = ANY(array) raw SQL, but those tests only compare Prisma.sql objects with toEqual and never run them. A syntax, type-cast, or array-binding error in the ANY queries would pass tests and fail in production with over- or under-authorization.

findings.title: Org scope drops personal bookings when org has no child teams
findings.body: packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts in buildOrgAuthorizationCondition only loads memberships when teamsFromOrg.length > 0. When an organization has no child teams, teamIds is still [orgId] but userIdsFromOrg is forced to []. The resulting org condition then contains only teamId = ANY(...) AND isTeamBooking = true and omits the userId = ANY(...) AND isTeamBooking = false branch, so org admins see zero personal bookings instead of org members personal bookings.
